0x000832.en: 「Th-this is as far as I go...!」

0x000864.en: 「With my skills now...@　this is my limit...!」

0x000B87.en: 「Kh! So this is as far as it goes...!」

0x000BC2.en: 「Getting beat in a place like this...!@　Not funny...」

0x000C16.en: 「I blew it...!@　Nothing to do but retreat...」

0x000C8A.en: 「Guh! Nothing to do but fall back!!」

0x000D00.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000D67.en: 「This is it... the rest is up to you.」

0x000DD5.en: 「Nngh! So they got the jump on me...」

0x000E13.en: 「No good, took too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000E60.en: 「Well, I'm beat. The rest is up to you.」

0x000E9E.en: 「Kyah! The rest is in your hands!」

0x000EE5.en: 「To think the Granzon... could be shot down...」

0x000F90.en: 「Kh... So I'm to be a falling star, then... Ejecting!」

0x001047.en: 「Ow ow ow... I give. I miscalculated.」

0x0010CC.en: 「U...ngh! So this is where I fall...!」

0x001180.en: 「I'm sorry. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x0011B5.en: 「Damn! Is this the limit of my strength...!」

0x0011F9.en: 「I can't fight anymore! I'm pulling back!」

0x0012A1.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still too green...!」

0x0012EF.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x0013AA.en: 「Sorry, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x0013D9.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001417.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x001446.en: 「I can't go on. I'll take my leave.」

0x0014D1.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll withdraw for now...!」

0x00154E.en: 「Tch...! I can't hold out after all...!」

0x0016F5.en: 「Guhhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x0019E3.en: 「Regarding the anti-Ruina battle off Ecuador's@ east coast... we repelled the enemy, but three@ Federation bases suffered catastrophic damage.」

0x001AA6.en: 「Also, no Melior Esse-Esse were confirmed@ in this engagement.」

0x001B3E.en: 「Air Christmas, Alpha Saber and Beta Saber@ downed roughly sixty Ruina units...@ our losses were minimal.」

0x001C49.en: 「South America still bears the strong stamp of@ the old-calendar nation-states, and its military@ organization is no exception...」

0x001CCF.en: 「Even under the Earth Federation banner,@ the old national armies coordinate poorly,@ and the theater command doesn't fully control them.」

0x001D8C.en: 「That's simply how things are.@ Not to the degree of the Middle East or Africa, but many@ resent a Federation dominated by the West.」

0x001E28.en: 「So I propose early PGS approval...@ Grant Gaia Sabers command authority over@ anti-Ruina ops, under the VP's special powers...」

0x001EE8.en: 「I believe it would allow far more efficient@ and effective operations.」

0x001F5D.en: 「But Ruina isn't our only enemy.@ To check anti-Federation factions after the war,@ we should secure South America's forces now...」

0x00202F.en: 「That would leave no room to let off steam.@ Many would lose their work.」

0x002097.en: 「But the very reason Gaia Sabers exists is...」

0x0020DA.en: 「A necessary evil is indispensable in every age.@ Plenty of people are inconvenienced when the 'enemy' vanishes.」

0x0021BD.en: 「Commander, there's more I'd have you hear.」

0x002204.en: 「At one of the bases Ruina attacked,@ the Steel Dragon Squadron appeared... and@ afterward, they clashed with Duminuss.」

0x002291.en: 「For a while now, Duminuss has consistently@ been targeting the Steel Dragon Squadron.@ Because they possess the <Chokijin>, no doubt.」

0x002335.en: 「So it would seem... but@ Duminuss wasn't the only one to appear there.」

0x0023A9.en: 「A survivor of the base testified to sighting@ a leopard-type and a fish-type unknown.」

0x002428.en: 「No visual records remain, but they were said@ to be white, sculpture-like objects...」

0x002490.en: 「Leopard and fish types... Could they be Shinboku?」

0x0024C4.en: 「I judged that likely too... which is why I'm reporting it.」

0x002513.en: 「If a bird-type appears, we can call it certain, but...@ what of the two unknowns' movements?」

0x002587.en: 「They acted as if hostile to Duminuss,@ then vanished at once.」

0x00261A.en: 「Yes... According to the Order File, the master of the@　Chokijin and Yokijin is said to be@　the god of Baral.」

0x0026AA.en: 「If they're of the same kind, Shinboku and Duminuss shouldn't fight.」

0x0026F6.en: 「It could also be read as protecting the Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x00275B.en: 「By legend, only two beings can command@ the Shinboku. In other words, one of them@ may be within the Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x002803.en: 「You're saying Machiaf has already made contact?」

0x002840.en: 「Yes. The Steel Dragon Squadron has fine@ Psychodrivers. Despite being hunted as traitors,@ they fight outsiders like Ruina and the Guests.」

0x002909.en: 「Not from greed, but by their own convictions and duty.@ Just as we chose the Steel Dragon Squadron,@ so too has Machiaf chosen them...」

0x0029AB.en: 「If so, then our strategy has borne fruit.」

0x0029F4.en: 「Yes. An ordinary soul, branded a traitor and@ hunted by his own people, would break at that point.」

0x002A89.en: 「The more trials we give them, the tougher they grow.@ The L5 Campaign proved as much.@ All that's left is how we finish shaping them.」

0x002B4A.en: 「Have each Saber pursue the Steel Dragon Squadron.@ That is the top priority right now.」

0x002BAF.en: 「Number 22 and the Psychodrivers aside...@ if Machiaf is with the Steel Dragon Squadron,@ pressing them may draw the Shinboku out.」

0x002C72.en: 「Confirm a third one and it's certain.@ The other answer we seek@ may reveal itself of its own accord.」

0x002D48.en: 「Until it's certain, we need them as insurance.@ I'd like to obtain them before@ the NV unit is completed, but...」

0x002DD5.en: 「They mean nothing without the pilots.@ Proceed carefully. If it comes to it, we can@ just make use of the squadron itself.」

0x002EBE.en: (If they've appeared at this very moment,@ then this is truly... the guidance of god...)

0x002F4E.en: 「Units 8 and 9 will roll out soon.@ Originally I meant to make Lieutenant Hugo and@ Lieutenant Aqua their pilots, but...」

0x003008.en: 「Sadly, it seems we won't gain their cooperation.@ We're now selecting pilots to replace them.」

0x003095.en: 「Just mount an AI0 like the mass-production@ Jinrai, and it'd be settled...」

0x0030FA.en: 「As I've said before, DFC can't be performed@ with an AI1 or AI0.」

0x003162.en: 「No... In time, I'll make it possible.」

0x00319F.en: 「Even so, to reach that point you'd need@ the DFC data humans have gathered, no?」

0x00323E.en: 「For now it's built to the same spec as Medius.@ That is, machine control by a human pilot@ working with an AI1.」

0x0032DA.en: 「Of course, it can also be operated by the human alone.」

0x00331A.en: 「Then I'll produce results on the next mission.@ I'll show that the AI1 is superior to@ the human-plus-DFC combination...」

0x0033C2.en: 「I'll prove it's the one fit to control both@ the TE Engine and Razumnanium at once.@ Then judge for yourself.」

0x00346D.en: 「Very well.@ So long as you can defeat either@ Cerberus or Garmraid.」

0x0034F2.en: 「...You mean Hugo and Aqua are no longer needed?」

0x003541.en: 「That's right, Major.@ If you too wish your son to live, produce results,@ together with Erde and the AI1.」

0x0035DB.en: 「In the next operation, Gamma Saber requests@ to sortie alone... and to coordinate with Delta Saber.」

0x003670.en: 「So we produce results ourselves.@ But... why Delta as well?」

0x0036CC.en: 「We'll need someone to clear the way, won't we?@ Yield the vanguard and Dr. Tomine will agree.@ This time, our target isn't the same as his.」

0x00377A.en: 「I'll speak to the doctor myself.@ Let's both strive to produce results@ and achieve our aims.」

0x003807.en: 「Show those two no mercy whatsoever.@ It'll be a hard choice for you, but...」

0x003896.en: 「A parent should think of their child first.」

0x0038D9.en: 「...I've no reason to be told such things by you.」

0x003973.en: 「That's right.@ To demonstrate the excellence of Jinrai and AI0...」

0x0039C9.en: 「Say what you like...@ you mean to spare Gamma losses and steal our credit, don't you?」

0x003A40.en: 「True, we've only the one Medius...@ so the results it could claim are trivial.」

0x003ACF.en: 「Our target is the TE Absorber alone...@ not the Double G.」

0x003B43.en: 「If that still doesn't satisfy you...@ we'll move on Delta's orders. However, the moment we@ acquire our target, we'll act on our own.」

0x003C15.en: 「Then I'll permit it.@ But if my Jinrai should shoot down@ the TE Absorber, I'll hear no complaints.」

0x003CF0.en: 「Huh... So piloting the G Bankaran@ is actually pretty easy.」

0x003D4C.en: 「Right, so easy even I could jump in and fight.@ It moves with your body, and the computer@ handles all the tedious stuff for you.」

0x003E0F.en: 「Kisaburo, the guy who built it, is a real genius.@ Just what you'd expect from Shouko's grandpa.」

0x003E8C.en: 「...Then maybe even I could pilot the G Bankaran.」

0x003ED5.en: 「If you're confident in your skills.@ The rider's gotta be strong, or it's just a dummy.」

0x003F3A.en: 「I did karate back in high school...@ and I've got <AM> battling experience@ over at Ruslan's place, too.」

0x003FD8.en: 「The G Bankaran's mine.@ I protect Shouko with it.@ I'm not handing it over to you.」

0x004093.en: 「And why'd you ask how to pilot the G Bankaran in the first place?@ You planning to fight too?」

0x0041CA.en: 「If I'm in the way... I'll go somewhere else.」

0x004204.en: 「...DyGenGuard and Aussenseiter...@　just as their name Guardian says, they exist@　to protect this world...」

0x0042A9.en: 「But Jinrai is just a tool for my father's grudge...@　even with Earth threatened by the Guests and the Ruina,@　that doesn't change...」

0x004363.en: 「Father... shattered the one faint hope@　I'd been holding onto...」

0x0043E4.en: 「Even made for a twisted purpose...@　I hoped it might one day protect the world...」

0x00444C.en: 「Then... why don't you make it so yourself?」

0x0044A2.en: 「Set Jinrai right with your own hands.」

0x00450A.en: 「First, find some way to capture Jinrai...@　then you rebuild it yourself...」

0x004572.en: 「I... believe Jinrai should be destroyed.@　To stop my father's obsession...」

0x0045F3.en: 「But then everything you've done@　would be for nothing.」

0x004652.en: 「If you helped develop Jinrai, then surely@　you could make it right again...」

0x0046DB.en: 「I... have no right to do that.」

0x00474D.en: 「Yeah. Simulate the machine's state@　for when it's released.」

0x0047AC.en: 「Release it...? Do that and@　the engine'll overheat, you know?」

0x004851.en: 「B-but it's too dangerous.@　One slip and the machine stops dead.」

0x0048B0.en: 「As long as Medius Locus uses@　Rasmnanium, we have to end this fast@　or it'll just repair the damage.」

0x004964.en: 「To stop him... to stop Captain Albero for sure,@　releasing the TE Limiter is the only way.」

0x0049DB.en: 「We're not fighting alone, you know?@　If we coordinate well with the others...」

0x004A4C.en: 「I know that.@　But I want to raise our odds, even a little.」

0x004AA5.en: 「Even at the cost of the risk to us?」

0x004AF2.en: （I'm out of time...@　I can't let the next chance slip away.@　I have to get the truth out of the Captain, no matter what...）

0x004BCB.en: 「...All right. I can't turn down@　my partner's heartfelt request...@　I'll run the simulation now.」

0x004CD0.en: 「First time we've met face to face.」

0x004D20.en: 「To think you survived that mess...@　You've got a knack for cheating death too.」

0x004D7F.en: 「I heard about it later...@　that you let me and Captain Albero escape...」

0x004DF3.en: 「You people pulled me out on the <White Star> too...@　I was just paying that back.」

0x004E82.en: 「I don't know the details...@　but don't throw away a life you got to keep.」

0x004F12.en: 「Who knows. I don't get it myself.@　Just looked at your face and thought it. Or maybe...」

0x004F9A.en: 「Intercepted a distress call from San Gomez Island!@　Looks like they're under Ruina attack!」

0x00504F.en: 「Yes...@　A remote island, a relay base for supply transport.@　What are your orders?」

0x0050CA.en: 「We can't ignore a distress call.@　The Kurogane will head to Iti Iti Island first.@　We change course at once and rush to San Gomez.」

0x0051C4.en: 「To think the Ruina would show up on an island this remote...!」

0x00520A.en: 「Are they just hitting whatever's there,@　or planning to use it as a relay point@　toward North or Central America...」

0x005294.en: 「Crushing small fry one by one won't cut it...@　We have to hit the source, the Antarctic ruins, fast...!」

0x005311.en: 「Don't rush, Joshua.@　The moment to break them will come.@　Just like in the Septempurm battle.」

0x00538C.en: 「For now, focus on the enemy before you.」

0x0053B4.en: （Just like he said... all I can do now@　is take care of what's in front of me, one thing at a time.）

0x005419.en: 「Guardian 1 to all units!@　Ratsel and I take the front!@　The rear will mop up the stragglers!」

0x0054AD.en: 「Ruina in the battle zone, readings gone!」

0x0054E7.en: 「Good. Tighten anti-air watch.@　Request Excellence Rescue@　to handle the rescue effort at the airport.」

0x005562.en: 「Unknown approaching! Crossing in from 6 o'clock!@　Altitude 5000, range 4, count 1!」

0x0055FB.en: 「No, judging by the speed,@　it's some kind of large transport craft!」

0x00569A.en: 「Multiple objects ejected from target Alpha!@　Descending toward us!」

0x00573B.en: 「Then it's not the Federation!@　Ready short SAM attack!」

0x00581A.en: 「All units, scatter and prepare to intercept!」

0x005845.en: 「Target group Bravo descending, shooting down the short SAMs!」

0x005903.en: 「The Shadow Army, like it's supposed to scare us.」

0x005981.en: 「This is no time for idle talk.」

0x0059A9.en: 「Mass-produced Double G, huh.@　What a waste, using them like this.」

0x005A6E.en: 「Bian NO ideal, legacy ALL destroy.@　We ARE supreme.」

0x005AC1.en: 「...Doctor Tomine's obsession hasn't wavered a bit.」

0x005B0A.en: 「Laughable.@　A soulless machine ninja can't beat our Double G.」

0x005B7F.en: 「Vice Captain, what's the enemy transport overhead doing?」

0x005BB3.en: 「It's pulling out of the battle zone,@　but by its trajectory, chances are high@　it'll circle and wait up top.」

0x005C43.en: 「Relay to all units. Watch for airborne reinforcements.@ Send up air units to@ pin or shoot down the transport.」

0x005CDC.en: 「...Sanger,@　I can't keep humoring Doctor Tomine's@　delusions this many times.」

0x005D64.en: 「Jinrai!@　Today, on this ground, I send you off!」

0x005DB7.en: 「Jinrai, don't think you can outrun my blade!」

0x005DFD.en: 「Jinrai,@　you lack something decisive...@　and that is why you can never surpass us!」

0x005E90.en: 「No matter how many of you gang up,@　I'll blast every last one of you away!」

0x005F04.en: 「Foul machines, surrender!@　This Rishu will cut you down with his blade!」

0x005F6C.en: 「Let's see just what the third Double G@　is really made of!」

0x005FC8.en: 「Everyone... please, destroy Jinrai...@　shatter my father's obsession...!」

0x006036.en: 「If my wish can't come true, then...」

0x006070.en: 「Are you really okay with that, Minaki?」

0x0060A4.en: 「Are you fine not setting Jinrai right?@　Denying everything you've done...@　are you fine just giving up?」

0x0061C8.en: 「Confirming now!@　There's no doubt it's been@　disabled, but...」

0x006244.en: 「Attack from above!@　Enemy approaching! Straight in from 10 o'clock! Count 1!」

0x0062AC.en: 「That settles our debt to Doctor Tomine.」

0x0062EF.en: 「Yes... whatever becomes of Jinrai after this@　is no concern of ours.」

0x0063DB.en: 「You won't get away! After them, Ratsel!」

0x006460.en: 「Now then, let's carry out our objective.」

0x006537.en: 「Can't wait!@　I won't let this chance slip away!@　Let's go!!」

0x0066B1.en: 「Right!@　All units, scatter by team and@　chase down Jinrai and Medius!」
